nodes.title: The Python Data Model
nodes.description: How special methods and the built-in types define Python's consistent object API, building a card-deck example and emulating numeric types, string representations, and collection behavior.

nodes.title: An Array of Sequences
nodes.description: Built-in sequence types, list comprehensions and generator expressions, tuple unpacking, sequence pattern matching, slicing, and when a list is not the right answer (arrays, memory views, NumPy, deques).

nodes.title: Dictionaries and Sets
nodes.description: Modern dict syntax and comprehensions, mapping pattern matching, the standard mapping API with missing-key handling, variants of dict, and set theory operations on sets and dict views.

nodes.title: Unicode Text Versus Bytes
nodes.description: Bytes, encoders and decoders, encoding errors, handling text files, Unicode normalization for reliable comparisons and sorting, and the dual-mode str and bytes APIs.

nodes.title: Data Class Builders
nodes.description: The standard library's class builders — classic and typed named tuples, type hints 101, and the @dataclass decorator with field options, post-init processing, and pattern matching on class instances.

nodes.title: Object References, Mutability, and Recycling
nodes.description: Variables as references, identity versus equality, shallow and deep copies, mutable arguments and defensive copying, and how del triggers garbage collection.

nodes.title: Functions as First-Class Objects
nodes.description: Higher-order functions, modern replacements for map/filter/reduce, the nine flavors of callable objects, parameter kinds, the operator module, and functools.partial.

nodes.title: Type Hints in Functions
nodes.description: Gradual typing with Mypy: supported operations, usable annotation types, Optional/Union, generic collections and mappings, ABCs, parameterized generics with TypeVar, and static protocols.

nodes.title: Decorators and Closures
nodes.description: Decorator mechanics and execution timing, registration decorators, variable scope rules, closures with the nonlocal declaration, memoization with functools.cache/lru_cache, and single-dispatch generic functions.

nodes.title: Design Patterns with First-Class Functions
nodes.description: Refactors a Strategy pattern case study from classes to function-oriented strategies, adds decorator enhancement and module introspection, and implements the Command pattern with callables.

nodes.title: A Pythonic Object
nodes.description: Builds a Pythonic Vector class supporting representations, alternative constructors, classmethod versus staticmethod, formatted displays, hashing, positional pattern matching, and __slots__.

nodes.title: Special Methods for Sequences
nodes.description: Evolves a user-defined sequence type across five versions covering duck typing, slice-aware __getitem__, dynamic attribute access, hashing and fast equality, and formatting.

nodes.title: Interfaces, Protocols, and ABCs
nodes.description: Contrasts duck typing, monkey patching, and structural typing: programming ducks, subclassing and defining ABCs, virtual subclasses, static and runtime-checkable protocols, and the numbers ABCs.

nodes.title: Inheritance: For Better or for Worse
nodes.description: Covers super(), subclassing built-in types, multiple inheritance and method resolution order, real-world mixins (ThreadingMixIn, Django, Tkinter), and coping strategies that favor composition.

nodes.title: More About Type Hints
nodes.description: Deepens typing with @overload, TypedDict, type casting, reading hints at runtime and their problems, implementing generic classes with variance, and generic static protocols.

nodes.title: Operator Overloading
nodes.description: When operator overloading makes sense: unary operators, adding and multiplying, the @ infix operator, rich comparison operators, and augmented assignment.

nodes.title: Iterators, Generators, and Classic Coroutines
nodes.description: The iteration protocol, iterables versus iterators, generator functions and expressions, itertools, lazy evaluation, subgenerators with yield from, and classic (generator-based) coroutines.

nodes.title: with, match, and else Blocks
nodes.description: Context managers and with blocks with contextlib utilities and @contextmanager, a pattern matching case study building a Scheme interpreter, and else blocks beyond if.

nodes.title: Concurrency Models in Python
nodes.description: Surveys processes, threads, coroutines and the GIL, building spinner and prime-checker experiments and reviewing what concurrency means for system administration, data science, and server-side web development.

nodes.title: Concurrent Executors
nodes.description: Uses concurrent.futures for concurrent web downloads and multicore work: Executor.map, process pools, progress display, error handling, and futures.as_completed.

nodes.title: Asynchronous Programming
nodes.description: Covers asyncio end to end: awaitables, native coroutines as humble generators, the all-or-nothing problem, async context managers, semaphores, executors, async servers with FastAPI, async iteration, and avoiding blocking or CPU-bound traps.

nodes.title: Dynamic Attributes and Properties
nodes.description: Wrangles semi-structured data with __getattr__ and computed @property values, including data-driven attribute creation, linked-record properties, caching, validation, property factories, and attribute deletion.

nodes.title: Attribute Descriptors
nodes.description: Builds attribute-validation descriptors step by step, covering overriding versus nonoverriding descriptors, overwriting descriptors in a class, and why methods are themselves descriptors.

nodes.title: Class Metaprogramming
nodes.description: Covers type as a class factory, __init_subclass__, class decorators, import time versus runtime, and metaclasses — including how modern features simplify or replace them and when to avoid them.
